purpose: Slicer module (Spanish UI) that runs a FreeSurfer recon-all-style pipeline on a T1 MRI. It then predicts epileptogenic cortical regions (Destrieux atlas) from sEEG features with a bundled ExtraTrees model, and shows them in 3D with scalp EEG and SEEG electrodes. It is meant for research groups working on epilepsy surgery planning.
summary: I read the CMake files, the pipeline scripts, the inference bridge and the installation, subprocess and sys.path code in Visualizacion.py. I found no malicious behavior, network transmission of data, or startup installs. The pip install of pandas, joblib, scikit-learn==1.9.1 and nibabel only happens after a consent dialog. Shell command injection is mitigated by ID and path validation. The packaging looks sound. Remaining points are non-blocking: scikit-learn is pinned exactly, generic module names are inserted into sys.path, the model comes from only 15 patients with no validation shown, the license is non-commercial, and `scm_revision` is `main`. The extension needs an external FreeSurfer install. Not exhaustively read: the 108 KB Visualizacion.py, the VisualizacionML files and soz_inferencia.py. Overall: minor issues.
not_checked: <parameter name="0">Most of Visualizacion.py (about 3,700 lines) was read only through targeted searches and excerpts.
questions_for_author: <parameter name="0">What is the training and validation provenance of the 15-patient ExtraTrees model, and may the model and demo data be redistributed under PolyForm Noncommercial?
